quarterly_data.signal: Clinical: positive topline results from the multiple ascending dose (MAD) part of the first-in-human Phase 1 trial of Kv1.3 ion channel blocker ZP9830 in 32 healthy participants (4-week treatment, safety follow-up to day 41): multiple doses were safe and well tolerated, with no dose-limiting safety findings and all treatment-emergent adverse events on ZP9830 non-serious and mild; PK parameters support trials of longer duration. A Phase 1b trial with efficacy endpoints in plaque psoriasis has been initiated, and a Phase 2 trial in an additional autoimmune disease is planned for initiation in H1 2027. CMO David Kendall: the data give the company the confidence to expand the development program and explore an additional autoimmune disease in 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: 32 participants; 4 weeks; Phase 2 start planned H1 2027
